lines.en: label chikachristmalloween1:
scene chikajk1
Once again, Chika Chosokabe arrives at a party as what most would call “fashionably late.” But in all actuality, fashion had very little to do with it.
lines.zh: Chika Chosokabe 又一次以多数人所谓的「时尚迟到」登场。但实际上，这跟时尚几乎没什么关系。

lines.en: Because, yes — she may have struggled getting her corset to hug her body just tightly enough to perfectly accentuate her waist without crushing her insides, but she would have been late regardless of that.
lines.zh: 因为，没错——她可能确实费了番功夫，才把束腰调到刚好贴合身体、完美衬托腰线又不至于把内脏挤碎的程度，但就算没有这茬，她照样会迟到。

lines.en: In fact, she was close to not coming at all. For being here and seeing her was sure to set off the same alarms she failed so miserably to turn off the night she acquired a taste for the flesh of a friend.
lines.zh: 事实上，她差点就完全不来了。因为来到这儿、见到她，必定会触发那些她曾惨败于关掉的警报——就在她尝到朋友肌肤滋味的那天晚上。

lines.en: Rabies had turned to cannibalism. And while that was slightly less dangerous from an outsider’s perspective, it was a lot more socially unacceptable because there would need to be intent to it.
lines.zh: 狂犬病演变成了同类相食。虽然从旁观者角度看这稍微不那么危险，但在社会上更不可接受，因为那需要带有意图。

lines.en: It was personally unacceptable too. Yet Chika threw herself into the fire again and wasn’t really sure why now that she was burning.
lines.zh: 这对她个人而言也无法接受。然而 Chika 还是再次投身火中，而此刻被灼烧着的她，其实并不真的明白为什么。

lines.en: Was it the same sort of compulsion that drives one to poke a bruise, she wondered? Or like wiggling a baby-tooth on a journey from mouth-to-sheet?
lines.zh: 她想，这是不是跟人总忍不住去戳淤青的那种冲动一样？还是像把乳牙从嘴里摇到枕边那一路的旅程？

lines.en: Because, if that were the case, she could take solace in the fact that it would only be temporary. And that soon, she would be “normal” again.
lines.zh: 因为如果是那样，她至少可以安慰自己——这只是暂时的。而很快，她就会重新变回「正常」。

lines.en: But a part of her wished it would last forever. And a part of her felt like the taste that still lingered in her mouth would be so much sweeter if she could only indulge again.
lines.zh: 但她的一部分希望这能永远持续下去。而她的一部分觉得，只要能再放纵一次，那残留在口中的滋味会甜美得多。

lines.en: scene black
: Rin! Look!
lines.zh: : Rin！看！

lines.en: : Oh hey, Chika! You-
lines.zh: : 哦嗨，Chika！你——

lines.en: scene chikajk2
: Woah. That, uhh...
lines.zh: : 哇。那个，呃……

lines.en: : Woah.
: I can rock Jirai Kei pretty well, right? Like, maybe I’ll start dressing this way outside of Christmalloween?
lines.zh: : 我穿地雷系还挺像样的吧？说不定以后除了 Christmalloween 我也这么穿？

lines.en: : Right. Yeah. My nose isn’t bleeding, is it?
lines.zh: : 对。是啊。我鼻子没流血吧？

lines.en: : Not yet, no. So you’ve either become stronger or just don’t find me cute anymore.
lines.zh: : 目前还没有。所以要么你变强了，要么就是不再觉得我可爱了。

lines.en: : “Cute” would be an understatement right now. You look like the type of girl I’d want to receive threatening text messages from.
lines.zh: : 「可爱」现在都算保守了。你看起来就像那种会给我发威胁短信的女孩。

lines.en: scene chikajk3
: Can you be more specific? Because I’ll send them right now if it will get your nose to bleed. I crave the ego boost and I’m wearing more clothes than normal this year.
lines.zh: : 能说具体点吗？因为要是能让你流鼻血，我现在就发。我渴望这种虚荣心的满足，而且今年我穿得比平常多。

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just the kind that tell me I’m not allowed to look at other people and that I need to be fully devoted to you or you’ll kill yourself and blame it all on me.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就是那种不许我看别人、要我全心全意对你，不然你就去自杀然后把一切都怪到我头上的短信。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, how about I just send you a selfie instead? I have a few from when I was trying stuff on at the mall.
lines.zh: : 哦。那，我干脆发张自拍给你怎么样？我在商场试衣服的时候拍了几张。

lines.en: : You’ll be forced to see me in my underwear, though. Hope that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 不过你会被迫看到我穿内衣的样子。希望没问题。

lines.en: scene chikajk4
: Yup. There it goes. There’s the nosebleed. Thanks, Chika. Appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。来了。鼻血流了。谢了啊，Chika。感激不尽。

lines.en: : Fuck yeah! Still got it!
lines.zh: : 操，太棒了！宝刀未老！

lines.en: scene black
: Come with me. Let’s get you cleaned up. I kind of want to talk away from the party for a minute too.
lines.zh: : 跟我来。帮你收拾一下。我也想离开派对聊一会儿。

lines.en: : Hm? Why?
lines.zh: : 嗯？为什么？

lines.en: : It’s loud in here, obviously. Let’s just hang out alone for a little while.
lines.zh: : 这里太吵了，明摆着的。我们就单独待一会儿吧。

lines.en: : Uhh...but I-
lines.zh: : 呃……可是我——

lines.en: : Rin, come on! I need your help with my laces anyway. This corset’s too tight for me to bend over.
lines.zh: : Rin，拜托！反正我也需要你帮我系带子。这束腰太紧了，我弯不下腰。

lines.en: : Oohhhhh god! Okay! I can...get on the floor and...do that for you!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦天哪！好！我可以……趴到地上……帮你做这个！

lines.en: : I mean...we can find a bench if-
lines.zh: : 我是说……我们可以找张长椅，如果——

lines.en: : I can get on the floor and do that for you!
lines.zh: : 我可以趴到地上帮你做这个！

lines.en: Phase one — complete. Chika had managed to lure her “friend” away from the party and was now just three more phases away from tasting her again.
lines.zh: 第一阶段——完成。Chika 成功把她的「朋友」从派对上引开了，而现在距离再次尝到她，只剩三个阶段。

lines.en: That wasn’t specifically why she was doing this, of course. She just happened to subconsciously plan out the steps it would take to get there and then even more subconsciously execute them.
lines.zh: 当然，她这么做并不 specifically 是出于这个原因。她只是碰巧在潜意识里规划好了走到那一步所需的步骤，然后又更加潜意识地把它们执行了出来。

lines.en: So if the two of them just manage to get locked in some sort of storage closet together and then have to take their clothes off because it’s far too hot, it would be an accident.
lines.zh: 所以如果她们俩刚好被锁进某间储物间，又因为太热而不得不脱掉衣服，那纯属意外。

lines.en: scene chikajk5
Plans are really just that, though. Something you want to do, but ultimately fail at before the ever-present need to adapt takes over.
lines.zh: 不过计划本来就是这么回事。你想做的事，最终却在那无处不在的、需要随机应变的需求接管之前就失败了。

lines.en: Chika used to believe she was good at that. After all, she adapted quite seamlessly to being the caretaker of a child when her mother died. And this was nowhere close to the tragedy that was.
lines.zh: Chika 曾经相信自己很擅长这个。毕竟，母亲去世后她相当无缝地适应了照顾一个孩子的角色。而眼前这事，远远比不上那场悲剧。

lines.en: But Chika was a different girl now than she was back then. And causing her to stumble at this point took little more than a poorly timed encounter.
lines.zh: 但 Chika 现在已不是当年那个女孩了。而此刻让她踉跄一下，只需要一次时机不对的偶遇就够了。

lines.en: : Oh!
: Oh?
: I think she means “hi.”
lines.zh: : 我想她的意思是「嗨」。

lines.en: : Yes! Hi! I didn’t...realize you were coming.
lines.zh: : 对！嗨！我……不知道你会来。

lines.en: scene chikajk6
: Work’s closed for Christmalloween. Figured I’d go where the food is. Know the room number by any chance? Noriko ain’t textin’ me back.
lines.zh: : Christmalloween 店里放假。想着哪儿有吃的就去哪儿。知道房间号吗？Noriko 不回我短信。

lines.en: : Noriko? So you guys are...really that close now? You’re texting her? Without being texted first?
lines.zh: : Noriko？所以你们……现在真的那么好了？你给她发短信？还不是她先发给你的？

lines.en: scene chikajk7
: I just asked her for the fuckin’ room number.
lines.zh: : 我就问了她一个他妈的房间号。

lines.en: : Yes, but why not me? I’m here. Why was she the first one you reached out to?
lines.zh: : 是，可为什么不是问我？我就在这儿。为什么她是第一个你主动联系的人？

lines.en: : I don’t know. She ain’t ever tried to throw me off a balcony, for one.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。首先，她可从来没试着把我从阳台上扔下去。

lines.en: scene chikajk8
: I feel like I should go. This appears to be a Chosoguchi problem that I need to stay out of.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我该走了。这看起来是个 Chosoguchi 家的问题，我得离远点。

lines.en: : Chosoguchi?
lines.zh: : Chosoguchi？

lines.en: : It’s the ship name I came up with for you guys when you used to hang out all the time and I would masturbate to fantasies about it.
lines.zh: : 这是你们俩老在一起玩的时候，我给你们起的CP名，而我就是对着关于你们的幻想自慰的。

lines.en: scene chikajk9
: You did what?
lines.zh: : 你做了什么？

lines.en: : Please tell me I didn’t just say that out loud. You’re very pretty. I think I’m dying.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我我刚才没说出声。你真好看。我觉得我要死了。

lines.en: : And I think I am gonna fuck off to where the food is and pretend I didn’t ever hear that.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得我要滚去有吃的地方，假装自己从没听见这句话。

lines.en: scene chikajk10
: I like Yumi’s idea! I think Chika should do that too and I should just go home!
lines.zh: : 我赞成 Yumi 的提议！我觉得 Chika 也该这么做，那我就直接回家了！

lines.en: : Rin, how about this? You go back to the room and I have a little chat with Yumi that you will not fantasize about. Okay?
lines.zh: : Rin，这样好不好？你回房间去，我跟 Yumi 聊几句——你不许对着这个幻想。好吗？

lines.en: scene chikajk11
: If that’s...okay with Yumi of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，如果……Yumi 没意见的话。

lines.en: : Chika, you’ve already apologized for the crazy lady shit. You ain’t gotta do it again. I’m over it, okay?
lines.zh: : Chika，你都已经为那些疯女人的破事道过歉了。不用再道歉一遍。我已经翻篇了，好吗？

lines.en: : It’s not about that. I just...it’s been a while and...I could use somebody to talk to. Which is why I’ll fuck off if you say no. But also, please don’t say no. I’m kind of desperate.
lines.zh: : 不是为那个。我只是……好久没见了，而且……我需要有人聊聊。所以你要是拒绝我立马滚。但也请别拒绝我。我有点走投无路了。

lines.en: : Ugh...fine. But only if you can promise me your friend here ain’t gonna write fuckin’ fan-fiction about this later.
lines.zh: : 呃……行吧。但你得保证你这位朋友待会儿不会写他妈的关于这事的色情同人文。

lines.en: scene chikajk12
: How did you know I wrote fan-fiction about you guys?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我写了关于你们的同人文？！

lines.en: : I mean...bye!
lines.zh: : 我是说……拜拜！

lines.en: scene chikajk13
: Did we really need to come outside for this? It’s fuckin’ cold out here tonight.
lines.zh: : 我们真有必要为这个出来吗？今晚外头他妈的冷死了。

lines.en: if chikalust10 == True:
: I had sex on this bench once.
lines.zh: : 我在这张长椅上做过一次爱。

lines.en: scene chikajk14
: Cool. So, good talk, but I’m going to leave now.
lines.zh: : 酷。那聊得挺愉快，不过我要走了。

lines.en: : Wait, no! I’m just...nervous and didn’t know how else to make the atmosphere less bad!
lines.zh: : 等等，别！我只是……紧张，不知道还能怎么让气氛不那么糟！

lines.en: else:
: We could hold each other for warmth.
lines.zh: : 我们可以抱着取暖。

lines.en: scene chikajk14
: Cool. So, good talk, but I ain’t about to make Rin’s fantasies become reality. Later, Chika.
lines.zh: : 酷。那聊得挺愉快，不过我可不想让 Rin 的幻想成真。回见，Chika。

lines.en: : Wait, no! I’m just...nervous and didn’t know how else to make the atmosphere less bad!
lines.zh: : 等等，别！我只是……紧张，不知道还能怎么让气氛不那么糟！

lines.en: scene chikajk15
: The fuck you gotta be nervous about? We both know you’d kick my ass if we actually wound up fighting.
lines.zh: : 你他妈有什么好紧张的？我们都知道真打起来的话你会把我揍趴下。

lines.en: : Yumi, I’m nervous because I am currently facing a crisis right now and the only person I can talk to about it is a friend who rightfully hates me after the way I treated her.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我紧张是因为我现在正面临一场危机，而唯一能说上话的人，是一个在我那样对她之后、理应恨我的朋友。

lines.en: scene chikajk16
: I don’t hate you, Chika. It’s just fuckin’...hard bein’ around you now. You ain’t the same girl anymore and that shit...kinda sucks.
lines.zh: : 我不恨你，Chika。只是他妈的……现在待在你身边很难受。你不再是原来那个女孩了，而那感觉……挺糟的。

lines.en: : All it takes is one more misunderstanding and shit between us is permanently fucked. So it’s safer to just fuckin’...leave it, right?
lines.zh: : 只要再有一次误会，我们之间就彻底完蛋了。所以更安全的做法就是他妈的……就这么放着，对吧？

lines.en: : It would be, yeah...And I know you’re doing fine without me, so if that’s what you want, then...that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 是啊，会这样……而且我知道没了我你也过得挺好，所以如果那是你要的，那……那也没关系。

lines.en: : But I’ve been struggling lately. And I kind of need an abrasive Yakuza princess to call me a fucking moron and snap me out of it.
lines.zh: : 但我最近很难熬。而我有点需要一个嘴毒的黑道公主来骂我一句他妈的白痴，好把我骂醒。

lines.en: scene chikajk17
: It ain’t about Chinami, is it?...
lines.zh: : 不是关于 Chinami 的事，对吧？……

lines.en: : No, Chinami is fine. This is, uhh...
lines.zh: : 不是，Chinami 挺好的。这事是，呃……

lines.en: : A much gayer problem.
lines.zh: : 一个基得多的问题。

lines.en: scene chikajk18
: ...What?
: Yeaaaaah...
: The fuck you mean a “gayer” problem? You didn’t catch Sensei with a fuckin’ dude, did you? You sure it ain’t just another misunderstanding?
lines.zh: : 你他妈说「基得多」是什么意思？你没撞见 Sensei 跟个男的在一起吧？你确定不是又一次误会？

lines.en: : No. But I...may have cheated on him. With a girl. Who I am now pretty sure I have a major crush on.
lines.zh: : 不是。但我……可能出轨了。跟一个女孩。而我现在很确定自己对她有很强烈的感觉。

lines.en: scene chikajk19
: And now I can’t stop thinking about her and it’s impacting my relationship with Sensei and she likes him too and I am pretty sure I am just going to die if I don’t figure this out soon!
lines.zh: : 现在我满脑子都是她，这影响了我跟 Sensei 的关系，而且她也喜欢他，而我敢肯定要是再不弄清楚，我就要死了！

lines.en: : Chika...it’s not fuckin’ her is it? You did this with Rin?
lines.zh: : Chika……该不会是他妈的她吧？你是跟 Rin 干的？

lines.en: scene chikajk20
: She was sad and horny! And I was angry and horny! That’s not a safe combination of things to encounter shortly after learning your boyfriend has fucked the entire class!
lines.zh: : 她又难过又想要！而我又生气又想要！在你刚得知男朋友把全班都睡了之后，碰上这两种状态凑一起，本来就不安全！

lines.en: : That girl liked you forever and you turned her down. You tryin’ to tell me you’ve just magically changed your fuckin’ mind and now you’re into her?
lines.zh: : 那姑娘喜欢你那么久，你却拒绝了她。你是想告诉我你他妈的突然改变主意，现在喜欢上她了？

lines.en: : I don’t know! Yes?! I don’t want to be! But if I have to see her acting all cute one more time, I can not be held responsible for what I am going to do!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！是啊？！我也不想这样！但要是再让我看到她卖一次萌，我可不对自己接下来要做的事负责！

lines.en: scene chikajk21
: Jesus fuckin’ Christ, Chika. We stop hangin’ out and you immediately convert to dykedom. Give me a fuckin’ break.
lines.zh: : 我操，Chika。我们才不一起玩，你就立刻转性向了。饶了我吧。

lines.en: : I still love Sensei too. But that’s just one more reason it’s getting harder for me to convince myself that the only real love he has is the one he has for me when I have feelings for someone else now.
lines.zh: : 我也还爱着 Sensei。但这也只是又一个理由——既然我现在对别人有了感情，我就越来越难说服自己，他唯一的真爱就是给我的那份。

lines.en: : Surprised you lasted this long. I was tryin’ to warn you about him forever. This shit was always bound to happen, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你能撑这么久我倒挺意外。我早就想警告你了。这事早晚会发生，Chika。

lines.en: : Well...maybe without the lesbian part. But still.
lines.zh: : 好吧……也许除了拉拉那部分。不过还是。

lines.en: : If you were me, what would you do?
lines.zh: : 如果你是我，你会怎么做？

lines.en: scene chikajk22
: Well, I ain’t fuckin’ the girl...so that kinda only leaves one option if you’re makin’ me choose between ‘em.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我又不操那姑娘……所以要是你非要我在他们之间选，那就只剩一个选项了。

lines.en: : Assuming you did like girls though. Would you try and go for Rin? Stay with Sensei? Or...try to make both work even if it goes against everything you’ve ever thought about love?
lines.zh: : 不过假设你喜欢女生。你会去追 Rin 吗？还是跟 Sensei 在一起？或者……试着让两边都成立，哪怕这违背了你一直以来对爱的所有看法？

lines.en: : Didn’t you just say a couple minutes ago that Rin likes Sensei now? Ain’t gunnin’ for her just gonna confuse her? Especially after breakin’ her fuckin’ heart?
lines.zh: : 你几分钟前不是刚说 Rin 现在喜欢 Sensei 吗？追她不就只会让她更困惑？尤其是在你伤了她他妈的心之后？

lines.en: : It does confuse her. And I feel horrible about that.
lines.zh: : 这确实让她困惑。我为此难受死了。

lines.en: : But I’m not really sure if she understands exactly how I’m feeling since it’s so fucking complicated that I don’t know how to talk about it without crying.
lines.zh: : 但我不确定她是否真的明白我的感受，因为这事他妈的太复杂了，我根本不知道该怎么说才能不哭出来。

lines.en: : Then she’s the one you’ve gotta talk to, Chika. Not me. I don’t know shit about romance and you know that.
lines.zh: : 那你要聊的人就是她，Chika。不是我。我对恋爱一窍不通，你知道的。

lines.en: : It’s less who I’m talking to and just...talking to someone in general that helps. Because if I didn’t get these feelings out, I probably would have just pulled her into a closet later and-
lines.zh: : 关键不是跟谁聊，而是……跟人说出来本身就有用。因为要是这些情绪憋着不发泄，我可能待会儿就把她拖进储物间然后——

lines.en: : Yeah, spare me the details. I don’t need to know about your weird closet fantasies. Just fuckin’...talk to her and...I guess text me again if you need more help not going insane.
lines.zh: : 行，细节免了。我不需要知道你那些奇怪的储物间幻想。就他妈的……去跟她谈，然后……要是还需要人帮你别发疯，再发短信给我吧。

lines.en: scene chikajk23
: Thank you, Yumi...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Yumi……

lines.en: : I really do miss you, you know...
lines.zh: : 我是真的很想你，你知道的……

lines.en: : The apartment is so much quieter now. You can come back whenever you want. I know Chinami would love to see you.
lines.zh: : 现在公寓安静多了。你什么时候想回来都行。我知道 Chinami 一定很想见你。

lines.en: scene chikajk24
: Yeah...maybe I can drop by again sometime. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许我哪天能再去坐坐。我不知道。

lines.en: : I’ve got enough going on right now. And I’ve been workin’ a lot, so...schedule’s kinda packed.
lines.zh: : 我现在事够多了。而且一直在上班，所以……日程挺满的。

lines.en: : I guess...I miss you guys too or...whatever, though.
lines.zh: : 我想……我也挺想你们的，或者……随便啦。

lines.en: : You can also vent if you want, Yumi. Unless...Noriko’s the one you’d rather talk to now.
lines.zh: : 你要是想倾诉也可以啊，Yumi。除非……你现在更想跟 Noriko 说。

lines.en: : It’s all good, Chika. The only thing really worth writin’ home about is my mom getting cancer anyway.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Chika。唯一值得一提的大概就是我妈得癌症了吧。

lines.en: scene chikajk25
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. Seems like she’s probably gonna live, though. So that’s good at least.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过看起来她大概能活下来。所以至少这是好事。

lines.en: : Sorry. Didn’t mean to drag the mood down and shit.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。没想搞得气氛这么低。

lines.en: : Your mom has cancer...
lines.zh: : 你妈妈得了癌症……

lines.en: : And I ranted to you about my problems?
lines.zh: : 而我却跟你倒了一堆我的破事？

lines.en: scene chikajk26
: I mean, how the fuck were you supposed to know? Ain’t something to get upset about. You ain’t ever liked her anyway.
lines.zh: : 我是说，你他妈怎么会知道？这有什么好难过的。反正你从来就不喜欢她。

lines.en: : It doesn’t fucking matter how I feel Yumi. I didn’t even ask.
lines.zh: : 我怎么想根本不重要，Yumi。我连问都没问。

lines.en: : I’ve been so focused on myself that it didn’t even occur to me that you might be struggling too...
lines.zh: : 我一直只顾着自己，压根没想到你也许也在硬撑……

lines.en: scene chikajk27
: And with this...
lines.zh: : 而且还是这种事……

lines.en: : Of all things...
lines.zh: : 偏偏是这种事……

lines.en: : What’s happened to me?...
lines.zh: : 我到底怎么了？……

lines.en: : Is this really who I am now?...
lines.zh: : 现在的我真的就是这样了吗？……

lines.en: : I don’t know, Chika. That’s somethin’ else I can’t help with.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Chika。这也是我帮不上忙的事。

lines.en: scene chikajk28
: Yumi, I-
lines.zh: : Yumi，我——

lines.en: : I’m good, yo. You ain’t gotta worry about me.
lines.zh: : 我没事，喂。你不用担心我。

lines.en: : It ain’t wrong to focus on yourself if that’s what works for you.
lines.zh: : 如果只顾自己对你有用，那也没什么不对。

lines.en: scene chikajk29
: Now, if you don’t mind — I’m hungry as fuck. And I’m gonna go grab some food. Want me to send your girlfriend back down if I see her?
lines.zh: : 那么，不介意的话——我他妈饿死了。我要去拿点吃的。要是看到你女朋友，要我叫她下来吗？

lines.en: scene chikajk30
: Chika?
lines.zh: : Chika？

lines.en: : I’m okay...
lines.zh: : 我没事……

lines.en: scene chikajk31
: Aight. Well, can’t say I didn’t try.
lines.zh: : 行吧。那我可算尽力了。

lines.en: : See you up there, I guess. Tell the brat I said hi when you go back home.
lines.zh: : 那楼上见吧。回家的时候跟那小屁孩说我问她好。

lines.en: : Okay...
: I’ll tell her...
lines.zh: : 我会转告她的……

lines.en: Yumi leaves.
lines.zh: Yumi 离开了。

lines.en: Chika is sad.
lines.zh: Chika 很难过。

lines.en: scene chikajk32
And it’s a violent sort of sadness. The kind that makes it next to impossible to breathe through your nose — where your head pounds and you start gagging due to the spasms in your throat.
lines.zh: 那是一种凶猛的悲伤。是那种让你几乎没法用鼻子呼吸的悲伤——脑袋突突地跳，喉咙一阵阵痉挛，让你开始干呕。

lines.en: She’d gotten used to crying lately. But it was never like this.
lines.zh: 她最近已经习惯了哭。但从来不是这样。

lines.en: It was always just feeling like a failure. It was never actually seeing the consequences of that.
lines.zh: 以前只是觉得自己是个失败者。从来没真正看到失败的后果。

lines.en: But she did tonight.
lines.zh: 但今晚她看到了。

lines.en: And she finally understood just how much she’d lost in her endless pursuit of happiness.
lines.zh: 而她终于明白，在无尽追逐幸福的过程中，她已经失去了多少。

lines.en: So she did what any girl her age would do.
lines.zh: 于是她做了任何同龄女孩都会做的事。

lines.en: She ran to the bathroom to cry some more.
lines.zh: 她跑进洗手间，继续哭。

And in there, she would cry, cry, and cry some more until the gagging was no longer just gagging.
lines.zh: 而在那里，她会哭、哭、再哭，直到那干呕不再只是干呕。

lines.en: Until her mascara ran so deeply down her cheeks that it dyed the collar of her brand new top.
lines.zh: 直到睫毛膏顺着脸颊流下那么深，把她那件崭新上衣的领子都染了色。

lines.en: The feel of the cold steel from her rings on her cheeks as she clawed at her eyes to fight off the tears was the closest she’d come to salvation that night.
lines.zh: 她用戒指的冷铁蹭着脸颊，抓挠着眼睛想逼退泪水——那是她那晚最接近救赎的时刻。

lines.en: But she’d fight that off too, punching the wall of a bathroom stall so hard that those rings would carve deep into the flesh of her fingers.
lines.zh: 但她连这个也要击退——她朝洗手间隔间的墙狠狠一拳打下去，戒指深深嵌进了她手指的肉里。

lines.en: Now, she’d notice the pain every time they wound up between her legs.
lines.zh: 从今往后，每次它们滑落到她双腿之间时，她都会察觉到那份疼痛。

lines.en: This is what she deserved.
lines.zh: 这是她应得的。

lines.en: All of this and more.
lines.zh: 这一切，以及更多。
